velocity_evaluation.posture: Finite states/actions and actual joint/actuator envelopes are mandatory. Validate posture limits by task and command; signed foot-site projection is a diagnostic proxy, not proof of mesh penetration or a universal turn/strafe failure. Previous 20-degree/1-percent proposal is retained in the planning snapshot, not accepted as a frozen new evaluation rule.
velocity_evaluation.metric: Planar L2 velocity error per first episode, then equal weight across episodes; never average away a failed command
velocity_evaluation.posture_threshold_status: Draft only; calibrate by command and valid geometry before freezing

standup_evaluation.standing: trunk height within 0.02 m of declared nominal height; tilt below 15 degrees; angular speed below 1 rad/s; both feet support; joint/actuator envelopes respected
standup_evaluation.guard: Phase-aware progress/timeout and numerical/actuator limits; fallen posture is expected, so walking fall/adduction tripwires cannot be reused

timing.time_origin: Reset at 0; release after 2 s; upright must be reached by absolute 8 s; then hold up to 3 s
timing.implementation_requirement: Evaluation timeout extended to 11 seconds; first-episode holds independently reconstructed; original training task remains 8 seconds.

roll_evaluation.success: One signed sagittal forward revolution, final cumulative angle within 30 degrees of 2*pi, valid full-body contact sequence and stable upright hold. Side rolls, back rolls, repeated turns and head penetration fail.
roll_evaluation.guard: Phase-aware progress, repeated unintended rotation, numerical failure and actuator limits; never use ordinary walking fall stop rule
roll_evaluation.interface_note: Angle variant consumes cumulative sagittal angle in one formerly padded observation slot; same input dimension does not imply compatible semantics
roll_evaluation.timing_note: Deadline at reset+7 s, followed by up to 2 s hold; evaluator must extend observation without reset, while keeping the 7 s maneuver deadline and original training task unchanged

training_strategy.paired_budget: Same declared parent, reset seed, environment count, rollout length, total transitions and update count; if one arm stops early compare common prefix and label failure
training_strategy.selection: Last completed checkpoint is primary; alternate checkpoint selection must be declared and evaluated once on heldout seed
training_strategy.standup_roll_budget: Set after reference evaluation and compilation/memory measurement; use bounded chunks with stage progress gates, do not assume walking cost or 250 updates can establish skill learning
training_strategy.teacher: Official ONNX is a frozen reference. No optimizer/critic state is present for PPO continuation. Imitation/distillation, if needed, is a separate controlled experiment.
budget_accounting: wall time excluding and including compilation/observation
training_strategy.probe_semantics: 50 updates is a bounded engineering diagnosis ceiling, not a convergence test. Faulty parents require a repair-aware monitor before launch. Freeze paired conditions before observing results.
training_strategy.extension_semantics: Each chunk <=250 updates to match current code limit; every chunk requires recorded progress and fixed evaluation before the next. 1000 is a reviewed cumulative ceiling, not an existing single-run option.
baseline_roles: Unmodified upstream reference with known outcome
Declared repaired engineering baseline if correctness changes are needed
Single-factor candidates compared against the fixed engineering baseline
training_strategy.parent_selection: Do not resume the newest or largest checkpoint by default; select a documented parent with usable posture/tracking evidence and matched interface. Teacher ONNX is not a full PPO checkpoint.
training_strategy.negative_result: Record tested budget and uncertainty. A failed 50-update probe is not proof that the hypothesis can never learn.
training_strategy.review_round_semantics: 1000 additional updates is the maximum cumulative extension in one reviewed round. Each execution chunk remains <=250; review outcomes before another protocol/budget. This is not a lifetime training cap or a guarantee of convergence.

S1a.deliverable: Validated exports of the completed head-command pair; fixed official walk reference; observation/home/action/control-period/collision audit
S1a.exit: Models and inputs traceable; all conversion checks pass; unresolved model/physics mismatch explicitly blocks learning

S1b.deliverable: Seven-command fixed evaluations and reference videos, per-command metrics; reuse valid existing five-command results and add missing conditions
S1b.exit: Parent choice and one repair hypothesis supported; no assumption that official source must already pass

S1c.deliverable: Repair-aware stop profiles, short-video observation, source capture and complete-update stop/recovery tested in an explicitly bounded live run
S1c.exit: Observed end-to-end behavior, no infinite restart or lost complete-update claim; monitoring overhead measured

S2a.exit: Stage-specific pass and no material regression in remaining four conditions
S2a.current_result: Official initialization preserved posture; ordinary adaptation and 0.25/0.10 reward-width pair did not improve motion. Reward incentive diagnosis precedes further learning.

S2c.exit: All seven commands pass; repeat promising comparison across declared seeds

policy_architecture.choice: Three task policies plus an explicit skill selector
policies: walk with zero and six directional commands
policy_architecture.interface_work: Define joint order, units, zero pose, action scale, reset state and command transitions in S1; physical execution deferred
policy_architecture.alternatives: Do not assume nine separate policies or force all skills into one policy before evidence

observation_plan.current_implementation: Real 3 simulated-second env 0 clips every 180 wall seconds, with first and abnormal clips, timing and metrics. Native VS Code playback verified; automatic browser refresh not verified.
observation_plan.target: Periodic 2-3 simulated-second clip at physically correct playback speed, plus current screenshot and metric trends
observation_plan.capture_rule: Record actual training states without extra policy inference or env.step; record sampled frame timing; never label deterministic replay as live training
observation_plan.overhead_target_status: S1c one sequential 50-update pair measured 4.18% added learning wall time; continue measuring each run
observation_plan.representative_cases: Keep env 0 for continuity; add labelled triggered bad-case clip and condition/regression videos, never use only a favorable environment

stop_policy_review.bounded_diagnosis: An inherited known defect first records a warning and a predeclared short repair probe; stop at its fixed budget without automatic continuation. New severe worsening stops sooner. Thresholds and warmup must be frozen before the probe.
stop_policy_review.regression: A qualified baseline can use stricter sustained-gait stops; recovery and roll need phase-aware rules.
stop_policy_review.current_code_limitation: Walking repair monitor and recovery evaluation verified. Roll evaluator has CPU boundary checks; real execution pending. Skill-training monitors and transitions remain to implement.

evaluation_levels.development: 32 first episodes per condition, fixed development scenarios; quick screening and regression only
evaluation_levels.confirmation: Three training seeds only for promising finalists; independent evaluation scenarios, with a proposed 128 first episodes per condition per selected model after resource check
evaluation_levels.holdout_use: Final assessment after selection, not reused to tune every candidate; declare seeds/scenarios before measurement
evaluation_levels.report: Counts and per-condition success fraction plus Wilson 95% interval; report each training seed, avoid treating time frames as independent episodes
evaluation_levels.claim_boundary: Empirical pass on a finite scenario set does not prove population reliability >=95%; confidence intervals do not account for model mismatch

protect: required media and full scalar metrics
storage_retention.reference_rule: Use canonical full paths and verified content hashes. A filename in a historical inventory alone is not an active dependency; preserve its tombstone/hash record after approved removal.
storage_retention.current_limitation: Existing cleanup tool conservatively protects a basename found anywhere, which can unnecessarily retain unrelated runs; do not use it as proof every intermediate is necessary
